Priya: morning — quick micro-check on synthia-mini quant onboarding
Priya: what I did: ran ~1k evals against the new promptset, warmed KV cache, merged the quant patch into staging
Priya: blocker: small repro where spanish date tokens shift when longctx > 2k, see repro steps below
Priya: repro steps (minimal):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD' -d '{"model":"synthia-mini-q","input":"January 1, 2020\nFebruary 2, 2021\nMarch 3, 2022","max_tokens":64}'
```
Priya: observed token misalign starting at the 3rd completion (tokens inserted before first date token)
Sam: re: repro — saw something similar on llama3-smallq last week, might be tokenizer -> KV-offset interaction
Sam: can you paste a minimal JSON payload I can drop into local harness?
Priya: minimal payload pasted below:
{"prompt":"January 1, 2020\nFebruary 2, 2021\nMarch 3, 2022","max_tokens":64}
Jorge: fyi I rolled a shadow job with the kv-patch on gpu-pool-3 — logs show mismatch at step 45
Jorge: logs: https://logs.redwood.dev/streams/abc123 (filter: synthia-mini-q, step>=40)
Marta: assigning to @Sam and @Jorge to pair on repro today, I can help if infra access or extra shadow runs are needed
Sam: happy to pair at 1pm PT; ping me in #eng-ml when you're ready
Priya: thanks — will leave notes in the onboarding checklist and add a focused unit test in the eval harness (promptset: dates-spanish-edgecases)
Devon: quick question: any perf regressions after the quant merge? I noticed ~+3% token p99 in synthetic longctx tests
Jorge: perf change looks tied to batch_size tuning; we bumped batch_size=8 which improved throughput but p99 rose on the longctx workload
Priya: plan for today: reproduce locally with exact payload, add test, try alternative tokenization mapping, then run full promptset overnight in staging
ci-bot: build succeeded — waffle/build-979 on branch quant-fix (https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/979)
Sam: got it, will triage after pairing. :thumbsup:
Marta: if blocked >2h -> flag on sprint board and I'll reassign capacity (dedicated shadow) to speed up repro
Priya: will update this thread after pairing and attach the unit test PR. thanks all :pray:
